avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction decreases ranolazine levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplement

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit extract/seed
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases ranolazine plasma concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue supplement; allow 7-day washout before ranolazine initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may elevate ranolazine levels; hepatotoxicity risk additive
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; consider alternative supplement with liver safety profile

caution_supplements.name: Coenzyme Q10
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance antianginal effects but limited clinical significance
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased efficacy; no dose adjustment typically needed

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive effects on cardiac function; theoretical interaction only
caution_supplements.action: Use standard supplemental doses; monitor for cardiac symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases ranolazine concentration and QT prolongation risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; counsel patient on hidden sources (Seville oranges, pomelo)

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase ranolazine absorption and plasma peak concentrations
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain constant intake pattern

monitoring_notes: Monitor QT interval prolongation risk, especially with CYP3A4 inhibitors that elevate ranolazine levels. Assess for dizziness, syncope, and cardiac arrhythmias during therapy initiation and with any interacting agent addition.
